CLMCE, hosted at the University of Glasgow with European partners, studies children's literature, media and cultural mediation for careers in publishing, libraries and cultural institutions. Recent application rounds have used a mid-January scholarship deadline; the live dates are posted on the Glasgow programme page.

Programme Highlights

  • Glasgow-led programme with deep publishing-sector connections
  • Mobility across European partner universities
  • Mid-January scholarship deadline pattern in recent cycles
  • Graduates work in children's publishing, media, libraries and research

Who Should Apply

Literature, education, media and cultural-studies graduates with an interest in children's media ecosystems are the core applicants.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: tuition coverage plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the CLMCE page on the University of Glasgow site for the current round's dates and apply through the university's postgraduate portal. Key deadline information: Annual round — recent cycles used a mid-January scholarship deadline; confirm on the Glasgow programme page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About CLMCE Consortium (University of Glasgow)

The CLMCE consortium is coordinated by the University of Glasgow and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Children's Literature, Media and Culture with European partner universities.

Official website: https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/erasmusmundus/clmce

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Annual round - see official page - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
